channel.description: Latest articles from Garden City Telegram (gctelegram.com)

item.title: ASKING ERIC: Wellness check severs decades-old friendship
item.description: Dear Eric: I’m a 73-year-old female who happily maintained a friendship I made my freshman year in college.

item.title: THE GRIDIRON AND THE GRAIN: Agriculture’s big role in Super Bowl Sunday
item.description: On Super Bowl Sunday, Americans consume approximately 1.45 billion chicken wings, along with endless chips, dips, and drinks (National Chicken Council, 2023).

item.title: Kansas Connections Academy opens enrollment for the 2026-27 school year
item.description: ELKHART – Kansas Connections Academy, a tuition-free, full-time online public school, is now enrolling students in grades K-12 for the 2026-27 school year. With more than 15 years of experience, the school offers an established education program to more than 1,300 students across Kansas.

item.title: February is ‘Love the Bus’ month
item.description: February is Love the Bus month, and Garden City Public Schools USD 457, along with other schools and communities across the country, come together to honor the iconic yellow school bus and the dedicated drivers who transport millions of students safely each day.

item.title: Garden City Achieve announces fall honor roll
item.description: Garden City Achieve High School, TEP, and Day School has announced its A-B honor roll for the fall semester of the 2025-2026 school year.

item.title: GCHS announces fall 2025-26 honor roll
item.description: Garden City High School has announced its honor roll for each of the academies for the fall semester of the 2025-26 school year.

item.title: Early child screening clinic taking appointments
item.description: USD 457, along with Russell Child Development Center, will hold a free developmental screening clinic for children from birth to four years of age who are Garden City residents.

item.title: Students advance to county spelling bee
item.description: Students from Finney County have advanced to the Finney County Spelling Bee that will be held at 9 a.m. on Saturday, Feb. 7, in Horace Good Middle School’s Clifford Hope auditorium, 1412 N. Main St.

item.title: School Board approves new ELA curriculum
item.description: The USD 457 Board of Education approved the new ELA curriculum at its regular meeting on Jan. 29.

item.title: County, City approve task order for Bypass study
item.description: The Finney County Commission approved a task order for a US Highway 83/50 Bypass study at its regular meeting on Monday.
